bind_address.description: IP address Prosody binds to for all incoming connections (e.g., '*' for all, '127.0.0.1' for local-only).

address.description: Optional binding IP address for this port (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or '127.0.0.1'). If null, binds to all interfaces.

ports.description: List of ports to listen on for client connections (XMPP, HTTP, BOSH, etc.).

ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify client certificates (recommended: true for client-to-server).

ssl_cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification.

hostname.description: XMPP domain (virtual host) name (e.g., 'example.com'). Must match certificate CN/SAN.

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual hosts (XMPP domains) to serve. Each must have a matching certificate.

type.description: Authentication backend type. Use 'internal' for Prosody’s built-in user management.

passwords_path.description: Path to password file or database (for external backends).

authentication.description: Authentication method and credentials backend configuration.

data_path.description: Base directory for data storage (user rosters, vCards, etc.).

target.description: Log target: 'info' (stdout/stderr), 'warn', 'error', or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/prosody/prosody.log').

modules_enabled.description: List of modules to load at startup (e.g., roster, saslauth, muc).

allow_registration.description: Whether to allow new user registration via in-band registration (XEP-0077). Disable in production.

max_idle_time.description: Maximum idle time (seconds) for client connections before disconnection.

max_stanza_size.description: Maximum stanza (XML element) size in bytes allowed from clients.

address.description: Optional binding IP address for S2S.

s2s_ports.description: Ports to bind for server-to-server (S2S) XMPP traffic.

s2s_require_encryption.description: Whether to enforce encryption (TLS) for outgoing S2S connections (recommended).

verify.description: Whether to verify certificates of connecting servers (false by default for backward compatibility).

items.description: IP address or CIDR subnet allowed to act as trusted proxies (e.g., for components or load balancers).

trusted_proxies.description: List of trusted proxy addresses for components or external services.
